message.content:
Build a production-grade Admin Integrations management page for a React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui SaaS app called ConvertScan.

## What to build

### 1. New page: `src/pages/admin/Integrations.tsx`

This page is the central hub for managing all external service integrations that ConvertScan uses as a platform. It should let admins see the health/status of every service, how it's configured, and provide quick links to external dashboards.

**Services to show (6 cards in a 2-col grid):**

| Service | Category | What to check | External link |
|---------|----------|---------------|---------------|
| Stripe | Billing | `VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` set? → if yes: "Configured", else: "Not configured" | https://dashboard.stripe.com |
| Anthropic Claude API | AI Engine | Server-side only — show "Configured via edge function secrets" | https://console.anthropic.com |
| Google PageSpeed | Performance | Server-side only | https://console.cloud.google.com |
| Screenshot Service | Visual Analysis | Server-side only (Railway/Puppeteer) | — |
| Resend | Email | Server-side only | https://resend.com |
| Supabase | Infrastructure | `VITE_SUPABASE_URL` set → "Connected" | https://supabase.com/dashboard |

**Each card should include:**
- Icon (use lucide-react icons that fit: CreditCard for Stripe, Zap for Claude, Gauge for PageSpeed, Camera for Screenshot, Mail for Resend, Database for Supabase)
- Service name + category badge (colored by category)
- Status badge: green "Connected" / amber "Server-side" / red "Not configured"
- Description (1 sentence)
- "Configuration" section showing the env var name(s) and whether they're set (for VITE_ vars) or "Managed via Supabase secrets" (for server-side)
- "Open Dashboard" button (ExternalLink icon) for services that have one
- For server-side configs, a subtle note: "Keys configured in Supabase Edge Function secrets"

**Status logic:**
```ts
const stripeStatus = import.meta.env.VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY ? "connected" : "missing";
const supabaseStatus = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL && import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY ? "connected" : "missing";
// All others: "server-side" (can't verify from frontend)
```

**Visual design:**
- Same card style as other admin pages: `border-border/50 shadow-soft`
- Status badges: green=`bg-green-100 text-green-700`, amber=`bg-amber-100 text-amber-700`, red=`bg-red-100 text-red-700`
- Category badges: Billing=`bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700`, AI=`bg-purple-100 text-purple-700`, Performance=`bg-orange-100 text-orange-700`, Media=`bg-sky-100 text-sky-700`, Email=`bg-pink-100 text-pink-700`, Infrastructure=`bg-slate-100 text-slate-700`
- Info banner at top: "Server-side secrets are managed in Supabase Edge Function secrets and cannot be viewed here."

**Page header:**
- Title: "Platform Integrations"  
- Description: "Manage and monitor all external services connected to ConvertScan."

**Summary row at top (4 stat chips):**
- Total integrations: 6
- Connected: count of "connected" status
- Server-side: count of "server-side"
- Not configured: count of "missing"

### 2. Update `src/components/AdminLayout.tsx`

Add to NAV_ITEMS array (between "Feature Flags" and "Support"):
```ts
{ title: "Integrations", href: "/admin/integrations", icon: Puzzle }
```
Also add `Puzzle` to the lucide-react imports.

### 3. Update `src/App.tsx`

Add lazy import:
```ts
const AdminIntegrations = lazy(() => import("@/pages/admin/Integrations"));
```

Add route inside the `/admin` route (after the `flags` route):
```tsx
<Route
  path="integrations"
  element={
    <Suspense fallback={<AdminLoadingSpinner />}>
      <AdminIntegrations />
    </Suspense>
  }
/>
```

### 4. Update `src/components/TopBar.tsx`

Add to `pageTitles`:
```ts
"/admin/integrations": "Integrations",
```

## Code patterns to follow

Read these files first to match existing patterns exactly:
- `src/pages/admin/FeatureFlags.tsx` — pattern for admin page structure
- `src/pages/admin/System.tsx` — pattern for status indicators
- `src/components/AdminLayout.tsx` — current nav items structure
- `src/App.tsx` — how admin routes are added

## Constraints
- No new hooks needed — all status is computed from `import.meta.env.*`
- Use `PageHeader` from `@/components/shared/PageHeader`
- Use `Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle` from `@/components/ui/card`
- Use `Badge` from `@/components/ui/badge`
- Use `Button` from `@/components/ui/button`
- No TypeScript `any`. Strict types.
- Production-grade — this is a real admin panel, not a demo
